svg.title: Spatial profiles along both paths
svg.desc: At 2.5, 3.5 and 4.5 ms, the high-voltage region has moved farther from the stimulated start. Distance is measured along the cable, with the shared junction at 3 mm. The lower daughter is narrower after the junction; the common trunk is identical in both panels. These are snapshots of one coupled calculation, not independent shifted copies.
